decision: May Routine 19 be completed, integrated and activated without a further founder decision once its readiness criteria are independently satisfied?
whyItMatters: Supersedes the previous R19 activation hold; R19 engineering moves to a separate native-Claude lane that must not displace Steward debt burn-down.
evidence: Founder authorization update 2026-11-06 (verbatim, section 3): "NEW FOUNDER AUTHORIZATION: Routine 19 may be completed, integrated, and activated once its operational readiness criteria are independently satisfied."

Readiness (verbatim list): complete authority, identity, clock and durable-outcome wiring; real shared coordination, CAS, leases and fencing; safe legacy-writer retirement and migration; correct failure, retry, unknown-outcome and recovery behavior; end-to-end and cross-process verification; independent full-feature acceptance; required exact-head CI and normal protected merges; verified provisioning and an observable rollback path.
"If readiness is incomplete, keep the current operational mode and finish only the missing safeguards. Never manufacture green status or weaken protection."
"Activation grants no additional authority to merge, close issues, alter trust/rank, accept deferred intakes or bypass existing kill switches." Existing disabled write permissions remain disabled.

Lane: native Claude Haiku/Sonnet subagents, optional Opus Medium; not the Steward Herdr roster. Only the designated coordinator modifies the canonical shared ledger; R19 agents must not activate competing writers. F3 remains binding.
"It is authorized, but it does not outrank the debt backlog."
recommended: Bounded readiness audit of 3bf9093b against the list, then finish only missing safeguards with independent acceptance, normal protected PRs, and a controlled, observable switchover.
